title: Contact
excerpt: A wrong result, a missing calculator, a file format we do not handle yet — this is the page for all three.
content:
Every message on this page is read by a person. There is no ticket robot and no autoresponder; the answer comes from whoever looked into the problem.

What to include

  • A wrong result. Name the calculator, paste the values you entered, and say what answer you expected. If you know where the expected answer comes from — a textbook, a standard, a spreadsheet — say so, and the fix is usually quick.
  • A calculator that should exist. Say what you were trying to work out and what you had in hand. “I have a room's measurements and I want paint litres by coat” is worth more than “please add a paint calculator”.
  • A file the tools will not open. Tell us the format and, if you can, what produced it. Do not send the file itself unless we ask — the tools run in your browser and we would rather keep it that way.
  • Privacy, advertising or licensing. Ask away. The privacy policy and the terms answer the usual questions first.

What happens next

Bug reports are answered first, usually with a fix rather than a reply. Requests for new calculators are collected and built in batches; when one you asked for goes live, that is the end of it. Anything about a particular page is answered by someone who has opened that page.

Before you write

Two things settle a good number of messages on their own: the FAQ covers units, blank fields, rounding and how to cite a result, and the note under any calculator explains the assumptions behind its answer. If neither answers it, the form below is the fastest route to us.

meta_description: How to reach the team behind Onim: report a wrong result, ask for a calculator, request a file format, or ask about privacy and advertising.
